caption: The drawing shows a wooden rocking chair with a black finish and yellow decorative patterns on the top rail and back splat, which include floral and leaf motifs. The chair features curved armrests with a slightly ornate turn and turned legs and supports, with additional yellow accents at points of joint or decoration. The seat appears to be woven in a light beige or tan color, possibly meant to represent rush or cane. The rockers are dark, and the front stretchers have a spiral or turned design. The composition centers the chair against a plain, light background with no additional objects or scenery. Handwritten text at the bottom labels the sketch as “Hitchcock Rocker–1830-40” and includes the artist’s name, “D. S. DeVault.”
title: Hitchcock Rocker
